steps.title: Seed cells in 60 mm dish
steps.instruction: Count the required number of cells, seed them in a 60 mm dish, and incubate overnight in a CO₂ incubator until the culture reaches 80–90 % confluency.

steps.title: Fix, permeabilize, and block cells
steps.instruction: Fix cells with 1.5–2.0 mL 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) for 10 min at room temperature, remove PFA, wash three times with 1.5 mL PBS, then permeabilize with 1.5 mL PBS containing 0.5 % Triton X‑100 and 10 U mL⁻¹ RNase inhibitor for 15 min at room temperature, wash twice with PBS, and block by adding 1.5 mL blocking buffer (supplemented with 10 U mL⁻¹ RNase inhibitor) for 1 h at room temperature. Cells may be stored overnight at 4 °C after blocking.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Remove blocking buffer, add 1.5 mL diluted primary (1st) antibody solution containing 10 U mL⁻¹ RNase inhibitor, and incubate for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary HRP‑antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Remove primary antibody solution, wash cells three times with 0.3 % Triton X‑100 PBS (gently shake dish for 5 min at room temperature each wash), then add 1.5 mL HRP‑conjugated secondary antibody diluted in blocking buffer (with 10 U mL⁻¹ RNase inhibitor) and incubate for 45 min at room temperature. Afterwards, wash cells three times with 1.5 mL 0.3 % Triton X‑100 PBS.

steps.title: In situ biotinylation
steps.instruction: Prepare biotinylation buffer immediately before use, wash cells with PBS, remove PBS and add 1.5 mL biotinylation buffer, incubate at room temperature for the previously optimized duration (time, biotin‑phenol concentration, and H₂O₂ concentration), then immediately wash three times with 1.5 mL PBS.

steps.title: Cell lysis and reverse crosslink
steps.instruction: After the final PBS wash, add 0.5 mL 1 % SDS RIPA buffer containing 20 U mL⁻¹ RNase inhibitor, scrape cells into a sterile 1.5 mL tube, sonicate with a Bioruptor (high power, 30 s on/30 s off for 20 cycles at 4 °C), then boil the lysate at 95–98 °C for 20 min (skip this boiling step when the downstream analysis is DNA or RNA), centrifuge at 15,000 g for 10 min at 4 °C, collect the supernatant as biotinylated lysate and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Avidin bead pulldown
steps.instruction: Dilute the biotinylated lysate 1:1 with 2× dilution buffer (RIPA without SDS) so the total volume is ~1 mL, set aside 50 µL as an input sample, wash avidin beads twice with 0.5 % SDS RIPA buffer, add 20–30 µL washed avidin beads to the diluted lysate, and rotate for 1 h at room temperature or overnight at 4 °C. After incubation, collect the flow‑through, then wash beads sequentially with 0.5 % SDS RIPA, 0.5 M NaCl RIPA, 1.2 M NaCl RIPA, and 0.5 % SDS RIPA (for each wash: centrifuge beads at 2,000 rpm for 1 min, add 1 mL buffer, rotate 5 min at room temperature). Optionally assess pulldown efficiency by western blot using streptavidin‑HRP.

steps.title: On‑bead trypsin digestion
steps.instruction: Rinse the beads three times with distilled water, resuspend them in 40 µL 2 M urea in 50 mM NH₄HCO₃, add 4 µL 100 mM DTT and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min, then add 4 µL 250 mM iodoacetamide and incubate at room temperature for 15 min, add 0.5 µL trypsin solution (1 µg µL⁻¹ in 50 mM NH₄HCO₃), and incubate at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Peptide desalting (StageTip)
steps.instruction: Condition a StageTip with 100 µL Sol B60 (0.1 % TFA, 60 % ACN) at 2,000 g for 2 min, equilibrate with 100 µL Sol A (0.1 % TFA, 2 % ACN) at 2,000 g for 2 min, load the peptide sample, wash four times with 100 µL Sol A at 2,000 g for 2 min each, elute first with 50 µL Sol B30 (0.1 % TFA, 30 % ACN) at 500 g for 5 min, then with 50 µL Sol B60 at 500 g for 5 min, collect eluate in a low‑binding tube and dry using a vacuum concentrator.

steps.title: Mass spectrometry analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze the desalted peptides by LC‑MS/MS on an Orbitrap Elite coupled to an UltiMate 3000 HPLC system. Load peptides onto a trap column (100 µm × 20 mm, C18, 5 µm, 100 Å) and separate on a nano‑HPLC column (75 µm × 18 cm, C18, 3 µm) at 300 nL min⁻¹ using a gradient of 2 %–33 % B (B = 0.1 % TFA in ACN) over 115 min, then 90 % B for 10 min, and re‑equilibrate at 2 % B for 20 min.

steps.title: DNA purification from beads
steps.instruction: Wash avidin beads with 1 mL TE buffer, remove TE and add 200 µL DNA Elution & Reverse crosslinking buffer, incubate at 65 °C overnight (12–16 h), add RNase A to a final concentration of 0.15 mg mL⁻¹ and incubate 37 °C for 30 min, add Proteinase K to 0.1 mg mL⁻¹ and incubate 55 °C for 2 h, purify DNA using the QIAquick PCR Purification Kit, elute in 10–20 µL nuclease‑free water, determine concentration with Qubit, optionally check enrichment by qPCR, store at –20 °C or proceed to NGS library preparation.

steps.title: RNA purification from beads
steps.instruction: Wash avidin beads with 1 mL TE buffer, remove TE and add 200 µL RNA Elution & Reverse crosslinking buffer, incubate at 55 °C for 1 h, add 500 µL Trizol LS, vortex, incubate 5 min at room temperature, add 130 µL chloroform, vortex 15 s, incubate 2–3 min at room temperature, centrifuge 14,000 g for 5 min at 4 °C, transfer the aqueous phase, add 1 µL GlycoBlue and 2.5× volume of room‑temperature 100 % ethanol, vortex 10 s, incubate 10 min at room temperature, centrifuge 14,000 g for 20 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, add 750 µL 75 % ethanol, centrifuge 14,000 g for 5 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, air‑dry pellet 1 min (avoid over‑drying), resuspend in 10–20 µL nuclease‑free water, determine concentration with Qubit or Quantus, optionally assess enrichment by RT‑qPCR, store at –80 °C or proceed to NGS library preparation.
